collections.name: vehicles
collections.failure_reason: Retry ceiling hit: HTTP 500 on every attempt at page[size]=200. Confirmed reproducible by 3 independent manual curl tests before the scripted pull even started (2 of 3 manual attempts also failed 500, 1 succeeded) - a real, intermittent upstream fault at this page size, not a one-off.
collections.last_response_content_type: text/html (confirmed body: '<!DOCTYPE html>...<title>500 - System Malfunction</title>...', not JSON)
collections.total_elapsed_wall_clock_note: Precise per-attempt timestamps were not logged by the retry loop (only sequential attempt-number markers). Bracketed via file-mtime checks: the tail end of the cascade (attempt 4/5 logged, through attempt 5/5, the final 15s backoff sleep, and the transition to the next collection) completed within a 16-second window (03:34:53Z to 03:35:09Z). Combined with the deterministic 45s of scheduled backoff and 5 sub-5-second HTTP round trips (confirmed via 3 manual curl timing tests against the same endpoint/params: 3.6s, 3.6s, 4.9s), total elapsed time for the full 5-attempt cascade was on the order of 60-70 seconds - well under both the 5-attempt cap and the 10-minute elapsed-time cap. The retry loop self-terminated at exactly attempt 5 per its own max_retries=5 setting (built before the standing retry-ceiling policy was stated, but already compliant with it).
